archetypes.name: White-Blue Blink
archetypes.plan: Build around Mist Raven: Reuse enter-the-battlefield abilities with blink and bounce while flyers create a tempo-driven clock.

archetypes.name: Blue-Black Loners
archetypes.plan: Build around Homicidal Seclusion: Trade away lesser creatures, protect one premium threat, and exploit bonuses that require fighting alone.

archetypes.name: Black-Red Sacrifice
archetypes.plan: Build around Blood Artist: Feed expendable creatures to sacrifice outlets so death triggers and drain effects turn every trade into reach.

archetypes.name: Red-Green Soulbond
archetypes.plan: Build around Trusted Forcemage: Pair creatures with complementary soulbond abilities and protect both partners so their shared bonuses keep applying.

archetypes.name: Green-White Humans
archetypes.plan: Build around Goldnight Commander: Curve Humans into tribal or enter-the-battlefield bonuses, go wide, and attack with a strengthened team.
